title: Crispy Canadian Baby Aubergine Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread recipe featuring crispy Canadian baby aubergine. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Slice the Canadian baby aubergine into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
Brush both sides of the aubergine slices with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Place the aubergine slices on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
While the aubergine is baking, toast the flatbread in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Once the aubergine is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Top the flatbread with the crispy aubergine slices and serve immediately.
Optional: sprinkle with crispy for added crunch.
